description: This file defines the RpcServer class, which manages RPC server operations including setup, session management, and connection handling within the Android platform.

classes.name: RpcServer
classes.description: Manages RPC server lifecycle, connection setup, session handling, and configuration within Android.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a new RpcServer instance with optional transport context factory.

methods.name: setupUnixDomainSocketBootstrapServer
methods.description: Initializes server using an existing Unix domain socket pair.

methods.name: setupUnixDomainServer
methods.description: Sets up server with a Unix domain socket at specified path.

methods.name: setupRawSocketServer
methods.description: Configures server with a pre-created raw socket file descriptor.

methods.name: setupVsockServer
methods.description: Creates server bound to a specific CID and port via vsock.

methods.name: setupInetServer
methods.description: Sets up IPv4 server at specified address and port.

methods.name: hasServer
methods.description: Checks if the server has been successfully initialized.

methods.name: releaseServer
methods.description: Releases ownership of the server socket FD.

methods.name: setupExternalServer
methods.description: Configures server with an externally provided FD.

methods.name: setMaxThreads
methods.description: Sets maximum number of threads for handling sessions.

methods.name: getMaxThreads
methods.description: Retrieves current maximum thread count.

methods.name: setProtocolVersion
methods.description: Sets the protocol version supported by the server.

methods.name: setSupportedFileDescriptorTransportModes
methods.description: Defines supported modes for file descriptor transport.

methods.name: setRootObject
methods.description: Sets the root binder object accessible to clients.

methods.name: setRootObjectWeak
methods.description: Sets a weak reference to the root binder object.

methods.name: setPerSessionRootObject
methods.description: Configures a factory for creating root objects per session.

methods.name: getRootObject
methods.description: Retrieves the current root binder object.

methods.name: setConnectionFilter
methods.description: Sets a filter function to accept or reject incoming connections.

methods.name: getCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves server certificate in specified format.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins server operation in background thread.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Blocks until server shutdown completes.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Attempts to shut down the server gracefully.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Returns list of active sessions.

methods.name: numUninitializedSessions
methods.description: Returns count of sessions not yet initialized.

methods.name: hasActiveRequests
methods.description: Indicates if server is processing requests.
